command_template_or_description: Run local static validator over manifest, candidate matrix, run plan, and recovery inventory.
reads_paths: rerun manifest; candidate matrix; run plan json; recovery inventory json
stop_condition: stop if validator reports missing keys or wrong row counts

command_template_or_description: Future human-run LLM-R2 runner availability probe wrapper. Requires separate human approval before any use.
reads_paths: runner scaffold; recovery inventory; candidate slice
writes_paths: runner readiness report; per-row runner notes

command_template_or_description: Future human-run logical-plan substrate probe on bounded PG slice. Requires separate human approval before any use.
reads_paths: runner readiness report; retained logical-plan notes
writes_paths: logical-plan substrate notes; substrate failure ledger
stop_condition: stop if logical-plan substrate fails before SQL extraction

command_template_or_description: Future human-run bounded PG-only generation dry-run wrapper. Requires separate human approval before any use and must not include database execution or timing.
reads_paths: approved candidate slice; runner boundary notes; substrate notes
writes_paths: per-row generation attempt log; retained raw outputs; generated sql files if produced
expected_outputs: generation attempt log and raw outputs
stop_condition: stop if route cannot produce bounded dry-run outputs safely

command_template_or_description: Future human-run extraction review step over bounded PG dry-run outputs. Requires separate human approval before any use.
reads_paths: retained raw outputs; extraction contract notes
writes_paths: extracted output sql files; extraction status ledger
expected_outputs: extracted sql files and extraction ledger
stop_condition: stop if output_sql cannot be extracted

command_template_or_description: Future human-run artifact retention verification over bounded PG dry-run outputs. Requires separate human approval before any use.
reads_paths: generated sql files if present; retention path contract
writes_paths: retention-path verification note; artifact completeness ledger
stop_condition: stop if generated sql path cannot be retained consistently

command_template_or_description: Future human-run failure-bucket assignment step using Stage-0 fail-closed policy. Requires separate human approval before any use.
stop_condition: stop if failure bucket cannot be assigned deterministically

command_template_or_description: Future local-only static artifact validation over bounded PG dry-run outputs without invoking databases.
reads_paths: failure bucket ledger; generation attempt logs; extracted sql files if present
stop_condition: stop if expected artifacts are missing or inconsistent

command_template_or_description: Future human review checkpoint before any execution, checker, or timing discussion.
reads_paths: all bounded dry-run artifacts; approval gate
